The installed AgentCall wrapper then logged `NativeTurnUnsettled: Secretary voice outcome is unknown`; terminal SDK receipt and secretary mode are unproven. The original utterance-boundary call and escalation canaries remain open.
external_waits: The current owner of the server-100 AgentCall voice runtime must install the already-reviewed SDK wrapper/bridge fix and confirm installed hashes; the live wrapper remains SHA c44c620b… while the reported target starts b6c2a590…. This lane will not duplicate voice-runtime edits. After that live readback, run one owner↔QA B Secretary SDK canary. Separate guest outbound acceptance, the original utterance-boundary recording, Matrix→Telegram→phone escalation, and final release/archive remain pending; no human/cellular call is authorized or needed for these checks.
